tape.argguy.friends.title: THE FRIENDS - capture_log_11.dem
tape.argguy.friends.line1: [00:12] "We have the drive. Rule from Azul's last demo: it holds perfectly still while someone looks at it."
tape.argguy.friends.line2: [00:40] "Second rule, from the research team: if you stare too long it starts to shake. Then it comes. Look away from it and it moves too. Trade off the stare."
tape.argguy.friends.line3: [01:55] "Compression runs in five passes. Every pass it gets louder. It can hear the drive working."
tape.argguy.friends.line4: [02:20] "The other team wants it alive. We want it gone. For Azul."
tape.argguy.researchers.title: UNKNOWN TEAM - demo classification memo
tape.argguy.researchers.line1: Type 1-2: ordinary. Type 3: it is nearby. Type 5: first-person from the entity. Type 6: remote deletion. Type 7: committed.
tape.argguy.researchers.line2: Fractured arrives with a wind chime and floats through walls. It moves only while unobserved, shakes when stared at too long, then charges. Water holds it back. It operates in groups. It does not kill. It relocates.
tape.argguy.researchers.line3: Subject appears sentient and reacts to being recorded. Do NOT compress it. Compression is not deletion.
tape.argguy.researchers.line4: The friends will try anyway. Make sure the machine is not connected to anything.
